parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { submissionId: $('Update Submission State').first().json.submissionId, finalizeToken: $('Update Submission State').first().json.finalizeToken || null } }}

={{ {
  run_id: $('Build Final Assets').first().json.run_id,
  workflow_code: $('Build Final Assets').first().json.workflow_code,
  status: (($('Build Final Assets').first().json.successCount || 0) > 0) ? 'success' : 'failed',
  finished_at: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' '),
  actual_completed_count: $('Build Final Assets').first().json.successCount || 0,
  result_summary: (($('Build Final Assets').first().json.successCount || 0) > 0)
    ? `WF-003 completed with ${$('Build Final Assets').first().json.successCount || 0} successful results and ${$('Build Final Assets').first().json.failedCount || 0} failed results`
    : 'WF-003 finished with 0 successful results',
  result_summary_url: ($('Build Final Assets').first().json.exteriorImages?.[0]?.imageUrl) || ($('Build Final Assets').first().json.interiorImages?.[0]?.imageUrl) || null,
  result_urls: [
    ...((($('Build Final Assets').first().json.exteriorImages || []).map(item => item.imageUrl))),
    ...((($('Build Final Assets').first().json.interiorImages || []).map(item => item.imageUrl)))
  ],
  external_task_id: $('Build Final Assets').first().json.client_request_id || $('Build Final Assets').first().json.submissionId,
  error_message: ((($('Build Final Assets').first().json.failedTasks || [])
    .map(task => `${task.type}#${task.index || '-'}: ${task.failMsg || task.failCode || 'failed'}`)
    .join(' | ')) || null)
} }}

parameters.jsCode:
return [{
  json: {
    ok: true,
    accepted: true,
    finalized: false,
    submissionId: $json.submissionId || null,
    taskId: $json.taskId || null,
    state: $json.state || null,
    resolvedCount: $json.resolvedCount || 0,
    expectedTasks: $json.expectedTasks || 0,
    message:
      $json.reason === 'task_not_found'
        ? 'callback accepted but task was not found in persisted state'
        : $json.reason === 'duplicate_callback'
          ? 'callback accepted, duplicate callback ignored'
          : $json.reason === 'already_finalized'
            ? 'callback accepted, submission already finalized'
            : 'callback accepted, waiting for remaining tasks'
  }
}];
